source.quote: after the overlap refusal the unparked session was left closed and never relaunched even once the lane was fixed. Reap requests that fail to launch are now held at status `retry` and re-asked each cycle.

prompt: Write reap.js in the current directory, exporting step(request, launch) and pending(requests) with CommonJS. A request is {id, status}. step calls launch(request), which returns true on success and false when the launch was refused. On success return a copy with status "launched". On refusal return a copy with status "retry", never a closed or dropped state. pending(requests) returns the requests whose status is "open" or "retry", so a refused launch is asked again on the next cycle. Reply with the single word done.

checks.name: refused launch is held at retry and re-asked
retry then success is launched and no longer pending
